lede: Tennis ran through Sunday's web. Aryna Sabalenka surfaced on both Google Trends and Polymarket at once, driven by her China Open match against Nikola Bartunkova, while Carlos Alcaraz sat at the very top of Google's trending searches. The day's single largest number came off Steam, where Counter-Strike 2 held more than 1.18 million players at once. A new RuneScape MMO teaser crossed from YouTube into Hacker News, and a magnitude 5.9 earthquake struck west of Tambolaka, Indonesia.

throughlines.title: aryna sabalenka
throughlines.gist: A tennis story that read as both a search spike and a betting market at once: Sabalenka drew Google Trends interest while her China Open match against Nikola Bartunkova moved on Polymarket.

throughlines.title: RuneScape - Official 4th MMO Teaser Trailer
throughlines.gist: A new RuneScape MMO reveal: the teaser trailer trended on YouTube while the development announcement drew discussion on Hacker News.

throughlines.title: Writing on the back of this reads “Daddy and our Baby”. 🥰 Photo from my collection, no date.
throughlines.gist: A single vintage photo, captioned from a handwritten note on its back, spread across the open social web and trended on both Bluesky and Mastodon.
